name: Catalog Mode for SureCart
author: sureplugins

sections.description:
Catalog Mode for SureCart transforms your SureCart-powered store into a beautiful product catalog. Perfect for businesses that want to showcase their products without enabling direct purchases through the website.

Whether you’re launching a new product line, managing inventory before going live, or simply want to use your site as a showroom, this plugin gives you complete control over what your customers see.

Key Features

  • Enable/Disable Catalog Mode – Turn catalog mode on or off with a single toggle
  • Hide Product Prices – Remove pricing information from product pages and listings
  • Hide Buy Buttons – Disable the “Add to Cart” and purchase buttons
  • Hide Quantity Fields – Remove quantity selectors from products
  • Disable Cart Functionality – Hide or disable the shopping cart entirely
  • Disable Checkout – Prevent customers from completing purchases
  • Easy Configuration – Simple, intuitive settings panel for all options
  • Granular Controls – Toggle each feature independently to suit your needs

Use Cases

  • Pre-Launch Catalogs – Showcase your products before you’re ready to sell
  • B2B Product Displays – Display catalogs for wholesale or business inquiries
  • Showroom Mode – Use your store as a product catalog for reference
  • Inventory Management – Take products offline temporarily without deleting them
  • Portfolio Display – Show off your product range without e-commerce functionality

Requirements

This plugin requires SureCart to be installed and activated on your WordPress site. SureCart is a modern, lightweight e-commerce solution built specifically for WordPress.

Get SureCart →

Settings

Once activated, navigate to SurePlugins > Catalog Settings in your WordPress admin to configure:

  • Enable/Disable Catalog Mode
  • Hide Product Price
  • Hide Buy Button
  • Hide Quantity Field
  • Disable Cart
  • Disable Checkout

Each feature can be toggled independently, giving you complete flexibility in customizing the catalog experience.

Developer Friendly

This plugin is built with clean, secure code following WordPress standards:
– Proper sanitization and escaping of all output
– Security nonce verification for form submissions
– Comprehensive input validation
– Follows WordPress coding standards
– Extensible architecture with hooks and filters

Privacy

This plugin does not collect, store, or transmit any user data. All settings are stored locally on your WordPress site.

sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin and upload it to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to SurePlugins > Catalog Mode to configure
  4. Toggle the options you want to enable

Alternatively, search for “Catalog Mode for SureCart” in the WordPress Plugin Directory and install directly from your WordPress dashboard.
sections.faq:
Do I need SureCart to use this plugin?

Yes, this plugin is designed specifically for SureCart-powered stores. SureCart must be installed and activated for this plugin to function.

Can I hide prices but still show the buy button?

Yes! Each setting is independent. You can toggle any feature on or off individually to match your specific needs.

Will hiding the cart affect existing customer carts?

The cart is hidden from display, but existing customers may still be able to access it directly. Use the “Disable Checkout” option to prevent purchases completely.

Can I use this plugin temporarily?

Absolutely! Toggle any feature on or off at any time. Your changes take effect immediately.

Is this plugin secure?

Yes. The plugin follows WordPress security best practices including proper input sanitization, output escaping, and nonce verification for all form submissions.

Can I customize which products show the catalog mode?

Currently, catalog mode applies to all products. We’re exploring per-product controls in future updates.

What happens when I disable the plugin?

All hidden elements will reappear, and all functionality will be restored to normal. No data is deleted.
